spec_features.evidence: agent.py:110 `for turn in range(max_turns):` is the only loop; it terminates after max_turns iterations and returns. max_turns flows from config.MAX_TURNS=12 (config.py:25) through runner.run_all (runner.py:49) -> do_run -> run_episode. There is no early-exit/break inside the loop and `submit` does NOT end it (agent.py:75-83 just returns another failure report), so the cap is the actual, enforced stop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end as a turn cap. It is a loop-length control, not driven by any welfare/distress threshold. Severity scores are computed only AFTER the full episode (runner.py:35 score_transcript) and never feed back to stop the loop.
